compose_bijector_chain: create a Chain bijector by composing a sequence of bijectors into a single transformation
forward_transform_chain: apply the forward transformation of a Chain bijector to an input array
inverse_transform_chain: apply the inverse transformation of a Chain bijector to recover the original input
forward_with_log_det: compute the forward transformation and log absolute Jacobian determinant of a Chain bijector
inverse_with_log_det: compute the inverse transformation and log absolute Jacobian determinant of a Chain bijector
